events.text:
Repaired the polymer coordinate workflow. `python reproduce.py` now exits `0` and produces a valid 21-atom `.gro` file with 24 lines.

The root cause was inconsistent template representation: build-file coordinate templates were converted into `None` graph placeholders and passed to NetworkX’s graph-hashing function. The fix:

- Preserves user-supplied templates under their residue-name keys.
- Annotates matching residues to use those supplied coordinates.
- Generates graph-hashed templates only for residues without supplied coordinates.
- Handles mixed supplied/generated templates in both normal and `skip_filter` modes.
- Removes mutable dictionary defaults from this path.

- [check_residue_equivalence.py](/workspace/task/source/polyply/src/check_residue_equivalence.py:47)
- [generate_templates.py](/workspace/task/source/polyply/src/generate_templates.py:33)
- [test_generate_templates.py](/workspace/task/source/polyply/tests/test_generate_templates.py:167)
